title: Karl Wolfe sees photos of a lunar megalithic city

as_told.title: Karl Wolfe shown photo of structures on far side of the Moon at Langley
as_told.place_text: Langley; far side of the Moon

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, relays the account of a man named Karl Wolfe, who he says was repairing a machine at an NSA facility (the NSA is the US eavesdropping and codebreaking agency) in the 1960s. While there, Wolfe says, he was shown mosaic photographs, taken by spacecraft orbiting the Moon, of a huge city of giant stone structures on the Moon's far side. Jorjani adds that Ingo Swann, a man known for remote viewing, which means trying to see faraway places with the mind alone, confirmed the city, which would mean someone built on the Moon long before us.
